The region of the selected workspace. The default value will use the Region selection above.

properties.displayName: File Event ASIM filtering parser for Halcyon
properties.query:
let parser = (starttime:datetime=datetime(null), endtime:datetime=datetime(null), eventtype_in:dynamic=dynamic([]), srcipaddr_has_any_prefix:dynamic=dynamic([]), actorusername_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), targetfilepath_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), srcfilepath_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), hashes_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), dvchostname_has_any:dynamic=dynamic([]), disabled:bool=false) {
    HalcyonEventsV2_CL
    | where not(disabled)
        and class_uid == 1001                                    // OCSF File System Activity (1001 only)
        and (isnull(starttime) or coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated) >= starttime)
        and (isnull(endtime)   or coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated) <= endtime)
    | extend
        EventType  = case(toint(file.type_id) == 2, "FolderModified", "FileModified"),
        _ActorPid  = toint(actor.process.pid),
        _ActorName = tostring(actor.process.name)
    | extend _ActorIsPlaceholder = (_ActorName =~ "unknown" and _ActorPid == -1)
    // Pushdown filters on raw OCSF fields.
    // NOTE: srcipaddr_has_any_prefix and srcfilepath_has_any are not applicable - Halcyon FileEvent emits no device IP and no source/old path.
    | where (array_length(eventtype_in) == 0 or EventType in~ (eventtype_in))
        and array_length(srcipaddr_has_any_prefix) == 0
        and array_length(srcfilepath_has_any) == 0
        and (array_length(actorusername_has_any) == 0 or tostring(actor.['user'].name) has_any (actorusername_has_any))
        and (array_length(targetfilepath_has_any) == 0 or tostring(file.path) has_any (targetfilepath_has_any))
        and (array_length(hashes_has_any) == 0 or tostring(file.hashes[0].value) has_any (hashes_has_any))
        and (array_length(dvchostname_has_any) == 0 or tostring(device.hostname) has_any (dvchostname_has_any))
    | extend
        TargetFileName      = tostring(file.name),
        TargetFilePath      = tostring(file.path),
        TargetFileExtension = tostring(file.ext),                              // populated only when the source event includes a file extension
        TargetFileSHA256    = tostring(file.hashes[0].value),                  // empty when the source event provides no file hash
        SrcFilePath         = "",                                              // Halcyon emits no source/old path
        ActingProcessId           = iff(_ActorIsPlaceholder, "", tostring(actor.process.pid)),
        ActingProcessName         = iff(_ActorIsPlaceholder, "", tostring(actor.process.file.path)),
        ActingProcessCommandLine  = iff(_ActorIsPlaceholder, "", tostring(actor.process.cmd_line)),
        ActingProcessSHA256       = iff(_ActorIsPlaceholder, "", tostring(actor.process.file.hashes[0].value)),
        ParentProcessId           = iff(_ActorIsPlaceholder, "", tostring(actor.process.parent_process.pid)),
        ActorUsername             = tostring(actor.['user'].name),
        ActorUserId               = tostring(actor.['user'].uid),
        DvcId                     = tostring(device.uid),
        DvcHostname_raw           = tostring(device.hostname),
        EventOriginalSeverity     = tostring(severity)
    | invoke _ASIM_ResolveDvcFQDN('DvcHostname_raw')
    | extend
        TargetFilePathType = iff(isempty(TargetFilePath), "", iff(TargetFilePath startswith "/", "Unix", "Windows Local")),
        Hash       = TargetFileSHA256,
        HashType   = iff(isnotempty(TargetFileSHA256), "SHA256", ""),
        EventResult = case(action_id == 2, "Failure", action_id == 1, "Success", "NA"),
        DvcAction   = case(action_id == 2, "Block", action_id == 1, "Allow", ""),
        EventSeverity = case(
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("Informational", "Info"), "Informational",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Low", "Low",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Medium", "Medium",
                            EventOriginalSeverity in~ ("High", "Critical", "Fatal"), "High",
                            EventOriginalSeverity =~ "Unknown", "Informational",
                            "Informational"),
        ActorUsernameType = _ASIM_GetUsernameType(tostring(actor.['user'].name)),
        ActorUserType     = _ASIM_GetUserType(tostring(actor.['user'].name), ""),
        ActorUserIdType   = case(isempty(tostring(actor.['user'].uid)), "", tostring(actor.['user'].uid) startswith "S-1-", "SID", "Other"),
        DvcIdType   = iff(isnotempty(DvcId), "Other", ""),
        EventStartTime = coalesce(HalcyonSourceTime, TimeGenerated)
    | extend
        Dvc          = coalesce(DvcId, DvcHostname_raw),
        EventEndTime = EventStartTime,
        FileName     = TargetFileName,
        FilePath     = TargetFilePath,
        Process      = ActingProcessName,
        User         = ActorUsername,
        EventCount   = int(1),
        EventUid     = HalcyonEventId,
        EventOriginalUid = HalcyonEventId,
        EventMessage = tostring(message),
        EventOriginalType = tostring(type_name),
        EventOriginalSubType = tostring(activity_name),
        EventProduct = "Halcyon",
        EventVendor  = "Halcyon",
        EventSchema  = "FileEvent",
        EventSchemaVersion = "0.2.2",
        AdditionalFields = bag_pack(
                              "halcyon_alert_id",         tostring(unmapped.halcyon_alert_id),
                              "halcyon_tenant_id",        tostring(unmapped.halcyon_tenant_id),
                              "halcyon_event_kind",       tostring(unmapped.halcyon_event_kind),
                              "halcyon_exploited_driver", tostring(unmapped.halcyon_exploited_driver),
                              "halcyon_targeted_product", tostring(unmapped.halcyon_targeted_product),
                              "halcyon_sub_type",         tostring(unmapped.halcyon_sub_type),
                              "halcyon_wdac_policy_guid", tostring(unmapped.halcyon_wdac_policy_guid),
                              "halcyon_wdac_reason",      tostring(unmapped.halcyon_wdac_reason)
                          )
    | project-away _ActorPid, _ActorName, _ActorIsPlaceholder, DvcHostname_raw
};
parser(starttime=starttime, endtime=endtime, eventtype_in=eventtype_in, srcipaddr_has_any_prefix=srcipaddr_has_any_prefix, actorusername_has_any=actorusername_has_any, targetfilepath_has_any=targetfilepath_has_any, srcfilepath_has_any=srcfilepath_has_any, hashes_has_any=hashes_has_any, dvchostname_has_any=dvchostname_has_any, disabled=disabled)
